why: MI-280 unit U13. Closes TWO rows: BL-20260903-RUN-GUARDS-REPORTS-FAIL-WHERE-THE-TEST-RUNNER-IS-ABSENT-SO-COULD-NOT-LOOK-READS-AS-BROKEN and its 2026-09-10 recurrence BL-20260910-THE-PYTEST-ABSENT-COUNTERMEASURE-IS-FILED-IN-AN-UNREAD-BACKLOG-WHILE-THE-BOARD-TELLS-SESSIONS-THE-OPPOSITE, whose own criteria say resolving the first resolves it. Tier-1 tooling: scripts/ci/**, tests/**, docs/claude/health-review-backlog.json. No src/, no config/, no deploy/, no order path, no strategy config, no risk cap. NOT landing machinery — checked by importing check_pr_landing.py and reading all twelve entries; the only match is the `.github/pr-landing/*.json` glob, i.e. this declaration, which R12 excludes by construction. THE INCIDENT: a session ran run_guards.py in a container without pytest, read `PASS 66 - FAIL 4, all four environmental, not the diff`, and shipped. CI then named TWO load-bearing defects sitting inside those very guards — a system-action absent from EXPECTED_ACTIONS, which would have MERGED LOOKING CORRECT and aborted the first time an operator ran an approved real-money-adjacent repair, and notify_run.sh with no priority mapping — neither reachable by any guard that does not need that runner. THE GAP WAS ROUTING, NOT KNOWLEDGE: the one-command remedy was already written down, inside a 1298-row backlog CLAUDE.md itself calls too large to read at session start, while the coordination board every session DOES read carried a true-and-incomplete note whose practical effect was to license discounting three guards. So the remedy had to arrive FROM THE TOOL at the moment the condition is hit. WHAT THE ROWS RULED OUT WAS NOT DONE: the board note is UNTOUCHED (it is TRUE, it was right to post, and treating a correct observation as the defect would discourage exactly the reporting this repo wants), NOTHING was added to CLAUDE.md (that surface's failure IS the row), and pytest was NOT installed in the container (BL-20260903 names that explicitly insufficient — it fixes today's instance and leaves the grader unable to tell the next one apart). OBSERVED END TO END with PATH narrowed so `ruff` is genuinely unreachable: `PASS 0 - FAIL 0 - COULD-NOT-RUN 1 - SKIP 0`, the per-guard line reads COULD NOT RUN, the message says in terms `this guard checked NOTHING. That is not a finding about your diff.`, the remedy `pip install ruff` prints AT THE POINT OF FAILURE, and the run exits 1. BL-20260903's criteria are met line by line: three states in the headline; could_not_run excluded from FAIL; not folded into SKIP; and the evidence is a command made unrunnable ON PURPOSE, not a green run. ⚠️ IT STILL FAILS THE RUN, DELIBERATELY — a guard that could not run is not a guard that passed, and in CI an absent runner means the image is broken; what changed is only that it can no longer be mistaken for a finding about the diff. ⚠️ THE PROBE ASKS THE INTERPRETER THE STEP WILL USE, not this process: find_spec here answers about whatever environment run_guards.py is in, which need not be the `python3` on PATH, and getting that wrong would report a runner present that the step cannot find — the same defect one level down. A planted defect that makes it ask this process is caught. ⚠️ AN UNRECOGNISED STEP SHAPE IS REPORTED PRESENT, failing toward RUNNING the guard, because turning a real failure into a silent could_not_run would be strictly worse than the defect being fixed. POPULATION for the remedy table: all 212 registry steps (python3 x210, 3 of them `-m pytest`; lint-imports x1; ruff x1), and a test asserts every runner the registry uses carries a recorded remedy so a new pytest-using guard inherits it without anyone remembering. VERIFICATION: 9 controls, 8 planted defects, 8 caught, positive control quiet on restore; the FIRST control is the negative one — a PRESENT binary is not reported missing — because a probe that called everything absent would satisfy every other assertion. ⚠️ THIS CONTAINER HAS pytest 9.1.1, import-linter AND ruff, so the condition cannot be reached by being in it: every control CONSTRUCTS it, and a green local run is not evidence here and was not treated as any. ⚠️ AND ONE THING THAT LOOKED LIKE A REGRESSION AND IS NOT: test_guards_uncommitted_work::test_only_a_guard_that_actually_runs_stays_quiet fails while this change is UNCOMMITTED because it asserts the clean-tree headline; verified by stashing and re-running that it passes, and on the committed tree 39 tests pass across the three run_guards suites.
